provenance.credit: Known B2/S35 spaceship described by Carter Bays (2005), with a matching RLE published by John Cerkan (2016). Independently recovered for this package.
provenance.note: Bays Figure 3 documents a period-5, one-cell-displacement spaceship in rule 3,5/2, equivalent to B2/S35. Cerkan’s 22 January 2016 RLE is 2bo$o3bo$2bo$bo2bo$6bo$2bo2bo$4bo!. Mapping Golly coordinates by (q,r)=(x,y-x) and comparing every complete orbit state proves exact equivalence to the catalogue: phase shift 2, rotation by one 60-degree step, no reflection, translation (3,0). The package’s independent constrained-search recovery does not make this a new spaceship. The earlier paper supplies scholarly context; its drawing was not independently transcribed in this audit.

provenance.credit: Illustrative seed constructed for this package using the standard additive/XOR cellular-automaton mechanism.
provenance.note: The three-live-cell initial pattern was assembled for the package, not mined from a soup or imported as an attributed published pattern. B135/S0246 computes the XOR of the centre and six neighbours. Over GF(2), powers of two of this linear update yield translated copies, giving the seven-copy demonstration once their supports are disjoint. The package claims this illustrative arrangement and its exact verification only; neither XOR replication nor the underlying algebra is a new principle. No external source is asserted for this particular seed.
